records.key: Adhesion opens the Invasion Assay, whose attached and invaded counts give the fungal cells bound to a host-cell monolayer. The planned Biofilm module will focus on collective growth, including covered area and thickness when the acquisition contains depth information. A single two-dimensional field can describe surface coverage but cannot by itself establish biofilm thickness. Choose single-plane or volumetric imaging to match the endpoint.
records.source: Adhesion opens the Invasion Assay, whose attached and invaded counts give the fungal cells bound to a host-cell monolayer. The planned Biofilm module will focus on collective growth, including covered area and thickness when the acquisition contains depth information. A single two-dimensional field can describe surface coverage but cannot by itself establish biofilm thickness. Choose single-plane or volumetric imaging to match the endpoint.
records.translation: A Adesão abre o Invasion Assay, cujas contagens de fungos aderidos e invasores dão as células fúngicas ligadas a uma monocamada de células hospedeiras. O módulo planejado Biofilme se concentrará no crescimento coletivo, incluindo a área coberta e a espessura quando a aquisição contiver informação de profundidade. Um único campo bidimensional pode descrever a cobertura da superfície, mas não pode, por si só, estabelecer a espessura do biofilme. Escolha imagens de plano único ou volumétricas de acordo com o desfecho.

records.key: Annotate this image for spaCR's community training data and send it to Hugging Face. Figure mode: box every well, for the well detector. Plaque mode: paint every plaque, for the next plaque model.
records.source: Annotate this image for spaCR's community training data and send it to Hugging Face. Figure mode: box every well, for the well detector. Plaque mode: paint every plaque, for the next plaque model.
records.translation: Anote esta imagem para os dados de treinamento comunitários do spaCR e envie-a ao Hugging Face. Modo figura: enquadre cada poço, para o detector de poços. Modo placa: pinte cada placa, para o próximo modelo de placas.

records.key: Antifungal response opens Dose–Response to fit fungal growth or a morphology score against drug concentration. Combining it with Morphology or Biofilm would help describe which image features change during treatment. Filamentation, Germ tube formation, Biofilm and Morphology are planned and their tiles are marked Coming soon. The Candida Genome Database and UniProt provide gene and protein annotations to support marker selection and interpretation.
records.source: Antifungal response opens Dose–Response to fit fungal growth or a morphology score against drug concentration. Combining it with Morphology or Biofilm would help describe which image features change during treatment. Filamentation, Germ tube formation, Biofilm and Morphology are planned and their tiles are marked Coming soon. The Candida Genome Database and UniProt provide gene and protein annotations to support marker selection and interpretation.
records.translation: Resposta a antifúngicos abre Dose–resposta para ajustar o crescimento fúngico ou uma pontuação de morfologia em função da concentração do fármaco. Combiná-lo com Morfologia ou Biofilme ajudaria a descrever quais características de imagem mudam durante o tratamento. Filamentação, Formação do tubo germinativo, Biofilme e Morfologia estão planejados e seus blocos estão marcados como Em breve. O Candida Genome Database e o UniProt fornecem anotações de genes e proteínas para apoiar a escolha de marcadores e a interpretação.

records.key: Anything that helps: microscope, magnification, cell line, what counts as one object.
records.source: Anything that helps: microscope, magnification, cell line, what counts as one object.
records.translation: Tudo o que ajudar: microscópio, ampliação, linhagem celular, o que conta como um objeto.

records.key: Epithelial invasion opens the Invasion Assay to distinguish extracellular fungi from those internalised by epithelial cells. Phagocytosis opens Host–Pathogen Analysis to measure uptake by phagocytes. Both require a way to resolve contact from internalisation, such as appropriate differential labelling or spatial information. Report the host-cell population and fungal morphology together with the uptake readout.
records.source: Epithelial invasion opens the Invasion Assay to distinguish extracellular fungi from those internalised by epithelial cells. Phagocytosis opens Host–Pathogen Analysis to measure uptake by phagocytes. Both require a way to resolve contact from internalisation, such as appropriate differential labelling or spatial information. Report the host-cell population and fungal morphology together with the uptake readout.
records.translation: A Invasão epitelial abre o Invasion Assay para distinguir fungos extracelulares daqueles internalizados por células epiteliais. A Fagocitose abre a Análise hospedeiro–patógeno para medir a captação por fagócitos. Ambas exigem uma forma de distinguir contato de internalização, como uma marcação diferencial adequada ou informação espacial. Relate a população de células hospedeiras e a morfologia fúngica junto com a leitura de captação.

records.translation: Todas as imagens curadas aqui com sua máscara salva ({n})

records.key: Gametocyte maturity is a proposed workflow for stage and sex-associated image features when suitable markers and reference annotations are available. Drug response imaging opens Dose–Response to fit an image readout against concentration. Record the species, starting stage and exposure duration with these measurements: changes in the mix of stages can otherwise be mistaken for changes in parasite number.
records.source: Gametocyte maturity is a proposed workflow for stage and sex-associated image features when suitable markers and reference annotations are available. Drug response imaging opens Dose–Response to fit an image readout against concentration. Record the species, starting stage and exposure duration with these measurements: changes in the mix of stages can otherwise be mistaken for changes in parasite number.
records.translation: Maturidade dos gametócitos é um fluxo de trabalho proposto para características de imagem associadas ao estágio e ao sexo, quando houver marcadores adequados e anotações de referência. A Análise de imagens da resposta a fármacos abre Dose–resposta para ajustar uma leitura de imagem em função da concentração. Registre a espécie, o estágio inicial e a duração da exposição com essas medições: caso contrário, mudanças na mistura de estágios podem ser confundidas com mudanças no número de parasitas.

records.key: Gliding motility opens the Motility Assay to measure the speed and straightness of extracellular parasite tracks. The planned Egress module will focus on vacuole rupture and parasite exit. Bradyzoite conversion will address stage-marker and cyst-wall readouts, while Host cell damage will describe monolayer loss. These three are proposed workflows, so their tiles are marked Coming soon. Fixed images, time series and stage-specific markers answer different questions and should be selected for the intended readout.
records.source: Gliding motility opens the Motility Assay to measure the speed and straightness of extracellular parasite tracks. The planned Egress module will focus on vacuole rupture and parasite exit. Bradyzoite conversion will address stage-marker and cyst-wall readouts, while Host cell damage will describe monolayer loss. These three are proposed workflows, so their tiles are marked Coming soon. Fixed images, time series and stage-specific markers answer different questions and should be selected for the intended readout.
records.translation: A Motilidade por deslizamento abre o Ensaio de motilidade para medir a velocidade e a retilinearidade das trajetórias de parasitas extracelulares. O módulo planejado Egresso se concentrará na ruptura do vacúolo e na saída do parasita. A Conversão em bradizoítos tratará de leituras de marcadores de estágio e da parede do cisto, enquanto o Dano às células hospedeiras descreverá a perda da monocamada. Esses três são fluxos de trabalho propostos, por isso seus blocos estão marcados como Em breve. Imagens fixas, séries temporais e marcadores específicos de estágio respondem a perguntas diferentes e devem ser escolhidos de acordo com a leitura pretendida.

records.key: If you can't train a model yourself, upload your images and masks here and we'll train one for you. Send the image on screen with its mask, every image you have curated here, or an images folder with a masks folder holding masks of the same names. Say what they show (organism, object type, stain) and they go to their own community dataset on Hugging Face as a pull request, which the maintainer reviews before any model is trained on it. They are shared under {licence}, so send only images you have the right to share. A careful mask makes a good model: every object, hugging its edge.
records.source: If you can't train a model yourself, upload your images and masks here and we'll train one for you. Send the image on screen with its mask, every image you have curated here, or an images folder with a masks folder holding masks of the same names. Say what they show (organism, object type, stain) and they go to their own community dataset on Hugging Face as a pull request, which the maintainer reviews before any model is trained on it. They are shared under {licence}, so send only images you have the right to share. A careful mask makes a good model: every object, hugging its edge.
records.translation: Se não for possível treinar um modelo por conta própria, envie aqui suas imagens e máscaras e treinaremos um modelo com elas. Envie a imagem na tela com sua máscara, todas as imagens curadas aqui, ou uma pasta de imagens com uma pasta de máscaras contendo máscaras com os mesmos nomes. Informe o que elas mostram (organismo, tipo de objeto, coloração) e elas vão para um conjunto de dados comunitário próprio no Hugging Face como um pull request, que o mantenedor revisa antes que qualquer modelo seja treinado com ele. Elas são compartilhadas sob {licence}, então envie apenas imagens que tenha o direito de compartilhar. Uma máscara cuidadosa gera um bom modelo: cada objeto, rente à sua borda.

records.key: Liver-stage growth is planned to measure parasite number and size within hepatocytes. Sporozoite motility opens the Motility Assay for gliding tracks, while Cell traversal will address host-cell wounding along parasite paths. Traversal, productive invasion and subsequent growth are different outcomes: their image markers, observation times and denominators need to be defined separately.
records.source: Liver-stage growth is planned to measure parasite number and size within hepatocytes. Sporozoite motility opens the Motility Assay for gliding tracks, while Cell traversal will address host-cell wounding along parasite paths. Traversal, productive invasion and subsequent growth are different outcomes: their image markers, observation times and denominators need to be defined separately.
records.translation: O Crescimento no estágio hepático está planejado para medir o número e o tamanho dos parasitas dentro de hepatócitos. A Motilidade de esporozoítos abre o Ensaio de motilidade para trajetórias de deslizamento, enquanto a Travessia celular tratará da lesão de células hospedeiras ao longo dos trajetos do parasita. Travessia, invasão produtiva e crescimento subsequente são desfechos diferentes: seus marcadores de imagem, tempos de observação e denominadores precisam ser definidos separadamente.

records.key: Parasitaemia opens Host–Pathogen Analysis, which reports infected red blood cells relative to all measured red cells. Blood-stage staging will separate rings, trophozoites and schizonts so a shift in stage composition can be examined alongside infection frequency. Merozoite invasion will focus on entry into red blood cells. Together these readouts would help distinguish fewer newly infected cells from altered development of parasites already inside them.
records.source: Parasitaemia opens Host–Pathogen Analysis, which reports infected red blood cells relative to all measured red cells. Blood-stage staging will separate rings, trophozoites and schizonts so a shift in stage composition can be examined alongside infection frequency. Merozoite invasion will focus on entry into red blood cells. Together these readouts would help distinguish fewer newly infected cells from altered development of parasites already inside them.
records.translation: A Parasitemia abre a Análise hospedeiro–patógeno, que relata as hemácias infectadas em relação a todas as hemácias medidas. A Classificação dos estágios sanguíneos separará anéis, trofozoítos e esquizontes, para que uma mudança na composição dos estágios possa ser examinada junto com a frequência de infecção. A Invasão de merozoítos se concentrará na entrada nas hemácias. Juntas, essas leituras ajudariam a distinguir menos células recém-infectadas de um desenvolvimento alterado dos parasitas já presentes nelas.

records.key: Parasitaemia, Sporozoite motility and Drug response imaging open existing spaCR modules; the other five tiles are planned and marked Coming soon. Their descriptions define intended readouts rather than available analysis pipelines. PlasmoDB and UniProt provide genome and protein context for choosing markers and interpreting results. The apicomplexan illustration is useful for discussing compartments shared with Toxoplasma, but it does not establish that a protein has the same location in both organisms.
records.source: Parasitaemia, Sporozoite motility and Drug response imaging open existing spaCR modules; the other five tiles are planned and marked Coming soon. Their descriptions define intended readouts rather than available analysis pipelines. PlasmoDB and UniProt provide genome and protein context for choosing markers and interpreting results. The apicomplexan illustration is useful for discussing compartments shared with Toxoplasma, but it does not establish that a protein has the same location in both organisms.
records.translation: Parasitemia, Motilidade de esporozoítos e Análise de imagens da resposta a fármacos abrem módulos existentes do spaCR; os outros cinco blocos estão planejados e marcados como Em breve. Suas descrições definem as leituras pretendidas, e não fluxos de análise disponíveis. PlasmoDB e UniProt fornecem o contexto genômico e proteico para escolher marcadores e interpretar resultados. A ilustração apicomplexa é útil para discutir compartimentos compartilhados com Toxoplasma, mas não estabelece que uma proteína tenha a mesma localização nos dois organismos.
